parakeet: Anecdotes start outranking data. Authority outranks evidence. A good story with a confident voice beats a boring chart every time. That habit doesn't stay in church. It travels. That's why religious superstition correlates so neatly with everyday scams. The same mental shortcuts that authenticate a miracle also authenticate an MLM.
